records.query: NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河在於其完整的硬體‑軟體平台與龐大的開發者生態系統，讓 GPU、CUDA 軟體堆疊、AI 企業套件與相關工具緊密結合，形成難以被競爭者複製的全端加速運算生態【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。

- **硬體與軟體深度整合**：NVIDIA 同時提供 GPU、CPU、DPU 以及高速互連的全套資料中心規模運算與網路解決方案，並在每代 GPU（如 Blackwell 架構）中加入 AI 專屬功能，確保硬體與軟體共同優化效能【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- **CUDA 生態與開發者基礎**：自 2006 年推出 CUDA 以來，已有超過 750 萬開發者使用其平行運算平台，形成廣泛的軟體庫、框架、演算法與 API，讓各行各業的 AI、科學運算與圖形應用皆依賴 NVIDIA 的技術堆疊【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】、【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- **AI 軟體套件與服務**：NVIDIA AI Enterprise 包含 NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints 等完整工具，協助企業快速開發與部署生成式 AI 應用，進一步鞏固其在 AI 訓練與推論市場的領先地位【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- **平台策略與生態合作**：NVIDIA 的平台策略將硬體、系統、軟體、演算法與資料集整合為一體，並透過與主要伺服器製造商、雲端服務供應商、學術機構與初創企業的合作（如 Inception 計畫）擴大市場佈局，提升平台的黏著度與價值【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】、【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
- **多元應用領域**：其技術已滲透至醫療、電信、汽車、製造等多個「數十億美元」的終端市場，透過統一的可程式化架構支援不同工作負載，進一步提升護城河的廣度與深度【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  

綜合以上，NVIDIA 以硬體‑軟體全棧、廣大的開發者社群、專屬 AI 軟體套件以及跨產業平台整合，構築了難以被取代的技術護城河。

records.query: NVIDIA 如何用同一套底層架構同時佈局資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用市場？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 透過同一套可程式化的底層架構（GPU、CPU、CUDA、網路互連等硬體與完整軟體堆疊），同時為資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用四大市場提供完整解決方案【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27】。

- **共通的可程式化架構**：NVIDIA 以 GPU、CPU、CUDA 與網路技術作為基礎建構塊，讓不同市場能共享相同的硬體平台與軟體介面，並藉由可程式化特性在多個「數十億美元」的終端市場中進行投資【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
- **資料中心 (Data Center)**：在資料中心領域，NVIDIA 結合高效能 GPU、DPU、NVLink 互連與 InfiniBand/Ethernet 交換機，提供整合的運算與網路系統，並搭配 AI 模型、加速函式庫、SDK 與雲端服務，形成完整的加速計算平台【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #25】。  
- **遊戲 (Gaming)**：遊戲產品線使用 GeForce RTX GPU、光線追蹤與 DLSS AI 超取樣技術，這些功能皆建基於相同的 CUDA 與 Tensor Core 架構，且在 Blackwell 架構下進一步加入神經圖形與新一代 DLSS 轉換模型，提升遊戲效能與畫質【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  
- **專業視覺化 (Professional Visualization)**：專業工作站採用 RTX PRO GPU，利用與資料中心相同的 Tensor Core 與 AI 加速庫，讓設計、工程與數位內容創作等工作流程在同一平台上獲得效能與 AI 功能的提升【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  
- **車用 (Automotive)**：車用市場的 DRIVE Hyperion 平台結合了高效能的 DRIVE AGX 硬體、車載作業系統 (DRIVE OS)、感測器套件與模組化的軟體平台，這些元件皆源自同一套 GPU/CPU/軟體堆疊，支援自動駕駛、地圖與停車服務等功能【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】。  

透過上述硬體、互連與軟體的全棧整合，NVIDIA 能在不同垂直領域提供統一且可擴展的解決方案，同時利用共通研發與生態系統提升各市場的競爭力【NVDA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。

records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 把 Copilot 作為 AI 驅動的增值功能嵌入 Microsoft 365 商務套件，成為提升每位使用者收入與雲端服務成長的核心策略【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。  

- 在 2026 年的 10‑K 中，Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品與雲端服務的說明中明確列出「Microsoft 365 Copilot」為組成要素，與 Office、Windows、Power BI、Exchange、SharePoint、Teams 等一起提供【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。  
- 同一段落指出，Microsoft 365 Commercial 的成長「依賴於在核心產品與服務中加入 AI‑enabled 工具、功能與 agentic 情境」，而 Copilot 正是這類 AI 工具的代表【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。  
- 2026 年第一季（截至 2026‑03‑31）財報顯示，Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入成長 19%，此增長「由 Microsoft 365 E5 與 Microsoft 365 Copilot 推動」且每位使用者的收入提升【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  
- 同期「成本」因「支援 Microsoft 365 Copilot 座位與使用量的 AI 基礎設施投資」上升 6.8 億美元（$680 million），顯示公司正投入資源建置 Copilot 所需的運算與資料基礎設施【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  
- 毛利額因 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端的強勁成長而提升 44 億美元（$4.4 billion），毛利率也因雲端效率提升而略有上升，間接說明 Copilot 帶動的雲端服務規模效應【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  
- 營運費用增加 7.95 億美元（$795 million），部分原因是「持續投資於 AI 人才、研發運算容量，以及 Copilot 廣告支出」，顯示 Copilot 不僅是產品功能，更是行銷與研發的重點投入【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  

綜合上述，Microsoft 透過以下三個層面將 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略：  
1. **產品組合嵌入**：將 Copilot 列為 Microsoft 365 Commercial 的核心服務之一，與其他生產力工具共同提供【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。

records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過把 Windows 內嵌於 Microsoft 365 產品組合，讓使用者在使用 Windows 時自然接觸到雲端服務與 Copilot，進而提升雲端與 Copilot 相關收入與使用者參與度。  

- 在 FY2026，Microsoft 365 Commercial 總收入較 FY2025 增加 **142 億美元（$14.2 billion），成長 16%**，其中 **Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入成長 17%**，主要受 **Microsoft 365 Copilot** 與 **Microsoft 365 E5** 帶動的每位使用者收入提升所驅動【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #127】。  
- 同期 **Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品收入（含 Windows Commercial on‑prem 組件）成長 13%**，這顯示 Windows 仍是產品收入的重要貢獻來源，透過 Windows 的授權與整合，促使企業在升級至雲端服務時同時採用 Microsoft 365 相關方案【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #127】。  
- 受 Windows 產品與雲端服務的結合效應影響，**Microsoft 365 Commercial 席位數增長 6%**，尤其是中小企業與前線工作者的採用，使更多使用者在 Windows 環境下啟用雲端與 Copilot 功能【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #127】。  

綜合上述，Microsoft 以 Windows 為入口，結合 Microsoft 365 套件與 Copilot，提升了雲端服務的使用率與收入成長，並透過 Windows 的產品銷售與授權，為雲端與 Copilot 的參與度提供了持續的動能。

The Ambitions That Drive Us

To achieve our vision, our research and development efforts focus on three interconnected ambitions:

•Reinvent productivity and business processes to help organizations and individuals work and collaborate more securely and efficiently. •Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform to provide a foundation for our customers’ digital workloads, including hybrid consistency, developer productivity, data and AI capabilities, and trusted security and compliance. •Create more personal computing experiences that empower people to play, create, and interact with technology in more intuitive, engaging, and dynamic ways. records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 正在透過持續擴大 AWS 基礎設施投資、加速 AI/機器學習相關人力與設備建置，並以大量股權投資與專屬融資安排深度參與 Anthropic 等生成式 AI 公司的發展，以支援長期雲端與人工智慧成長。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #97]  

**1. 基礎設施與 AI 相關的技術與基礎建設支出**  
- Amazon 表示未來會增加技術與基礎設施支出，因為要持續增添伺服器、資料中心設備與相關人員，以支援 AWS 以及人工智慧與機器學習計畫，這會在短期內壓低自由現金流。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #97]  
- 2025 年技術與基礎設施成本較前一年上升，主要是基礎設施（包括折舊與攤銷）的支出增加，外匯變動亦使成本上升 3.12 億美元（$312 million）。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #119]  
- 2026 年第二季（Q2 2026）與前一年同季比較，技術與基礎設施成本同樣因基礎設施支出上升而增加，六個月期間因外匯變動額外增加 4.27 億美元（$427 million）。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79]  

**2. 與 Anthropic 的股權與融資安排**  
- 截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Amazon 在未列入權益法的私營公司（主要包括 Anthropic 與 OpenAI）之股權投資帳面價值為 162 億美元（$16.2 billion）；至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，該帳面價值升至 1,223 億美元（$122.3 billion），顯示對 Anthropic 等 AI 公司的投資規模大幅擴張。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40]  
- 在 2026 年第一季（Q1 2026），Amazon 投資了 50 億美元（$5.0 billion） 於 Anthropic 的非投票優先股，並於同季修訂了 AWS 雲端服務商業安排，加入了與 AWS 晶片相關的合約義務。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38]  
- Amazon 為 Anthropic 設立了一筆最高 200 億美元（$20.0 billion） 的融資設施，於 30 個月內在 Anthropic 完成首次公開發行或其他流動性事件後到期；該設施在達成特定運算容量交付里程碑時可逐步釋放，並可透過新發行的 Anthropic 可轉換債券或未來的普通股取得回報。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38]  
- 此外，Amazon 持有對 Anthropic 未來股權融資的選擇權，最高可投資 50 億美元（$5.0 billion），行使此選項將減少上述 200 億美元（$20.0 billion） 設施的可用金額。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38]  

**3. 與 OpenAI 的類似策略（提供對 AI 生態系的整體布局）**  
- Amazon 在 2025 年底持有 150 億美元（$15.0 billion） 的 OpenAI Series C 優先股，並簽署了價值 350 億美元（$35.0 billion） 的「承諾購買」協議，計畫在未來以相同價格購買剩餘的 Series C 優先股，若 OpenAI 完成 IPO 或其他上市事件，該優先股將轉換為普通股。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40]  
- 2026 年第二季（Q2 2026）已投入 137 億美元（$13.7 billion） 於 OpenAI Series C 優先股，並在資產負債表上列示相關投資的公允價值為 1,223 億美元（$122.3 billion）（含 Anthropic 與 OpenAI）。[AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40]  

**4. 整體投資策略概括**  
- **持續擴大 AWS 基礎設施**：透過增加伺服器、資料中心設備與相關折舊攤銷支出，提升雲端運算與 AI 服務的規模與效能。  
- **加速 AI/ML 人才與研發投入**：將更多人力與研發預算投入 AI/機器學習領域，並在 AWS 服務中整合 AI 晶片與模型。  
- **股權與融資雙管齊下**：以大額股權投資（Anthropic、OpenAI）及專屬融資設施（最高 200 億美元（$20 billion））取得技術合作與未來收益，同時保留購買額外股份的選擇權，以確保在生成式 AI 市場的戰略位置。  
- **成本與風險管理**：大部分技術與基礎設施成本即時費用化，僅在衛星網路等特定項目達到商業可行性後才資本化，並透過外匯風險敞口（如 2025 年 3.12 億美元（$312 million）、2026 年六個月 4.27 億美元（$427 million））進行監控。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #119]  

綜合上述，Amazon 的策略是以「加碼 AWS 基礎設施、同步擴張 AI/ML 能力」為核心，並透過對 Anthropic 等前沿 AI 公司的巨額股權與專屬融資安排，確保在雲端與生成式 AI 市場的長期領先與收益。

We expect variability in inventory turnover over time since it is affected by numerous factors, including our product mix, the mix of sales by us and by third-party sellers, our continuing focus on in-stock inventory availability and selection of product offerings, supply chain disruptions and resulting vendor lead times, our investment in new geographies and product lines, and the extent to which we choose to utilize third-party fulfillment providers. time since they are affected by several factors, including the mix of product sales, the mix of sales by third-party sellers, the mix of suppliers, seasonality, and changes in payment and other terms over time, including the effect of balancing pricing and timing of payment terms with suppliers. We expect spending in technology and infrastructure will increase over time, which can negatively impact short-term free cash flow, as we add infrastructure and employees, including to support our artificial intelligence and machine learning initiatives, to support long-term growth. Our technology and infrastructure investment and capital spending projects often support a variety of product and service offerings due to geographic expansion and the cross-functionality of our systems and operations. We seek to invest efficiently in several areas of technology and infrastructure, including AWS, and expansion of new and existing product categories and service offerings, as well as in infrastructure to enhance the customer experience and improve our process efficiencies. records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨的主要反壟斷與監管風險如下：

1. **競爭與消費者保護調查**  
   - 亞馬遜正被多個政府機關調查，指稱其店舖營運（包括履行網路與 Prime 服務）以及 AWS 雲端服務可能違反競爭相關或消費者保護規則【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #81】。  
   - 這些調查同時涵蓋對 AWS Nitro 系統的專利侵權指控，顯示雲端業務亦受技術與競爭雙重審查【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45】。

2. **反壟斷訴訟與指控**  
   - 私人原告、州檢察長與聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）在美國、加拿大與英國提出多項訴訟，指稱 Amazon 進行價格固定、濫用支配地位、試圖壟斷線上超級商店、市場服務與中介服務，並在定價、Featured Offers、賣家資料使用、廣告、Prime 結構與自有商品推廣上採取反競爭做法【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45】。  
   - 這些訴訟要求的賠償金額高達數十億美元，且部分指控已在美國法院獲得部分認可【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #45】。

3. **稅務與地方監管挑戰**  
   - 在意大利，Amazon 正面臨稅務及其他監管挑戰，相關調查亦被列為「正式或非正式的審查」之一【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #124】、【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #125】。  
   - 這些稅務調查可能導致罰款或其他財務影響，進一步增加合規成本。

4. **中國與印度的營運限制**  
   - 中國與印度的監管機構對外國投資、互聯網內容、資料中心、零售與物流等領域設定許可與所有權要求，迫使 Amazon 必須透過持有本地牌照的第三方合作提供部分技術服務，增加營運複雜度與合規風險【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #63】。  
   - 這些規範若再度收緊，可能限制 Amazon 在當地的業務擴張與服務提供。

5. **資料隱私與安全監管**  
   - Amazon 亦受到日益嚴格的資料收集、使用與披露規範的審查，相關法律與解釋仍在演變，增加未來合規成本與營運不確定性【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #81】。

綜合以上，Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 以及整體電商平台上，同時面臨競爭法、消費者保護法、稅務法、跨國投資與資料隱私等多層面的監管與反壟斷風險。

- **搜尋與相關功能**：Gemini 3 被整合至 Google Search，提供「AI Overviews」與「AI Mode」等功能，讓使用者能以自然語言提出更複雜的問題，並利用 Gemini 的先進推理與多模態能力得到更完整的答案【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。同時，所有 15 個擁有超過五億使用者的產品（包括 Search）皆使用 Gemini 模型【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。

- **Google Workspace（工作平台）**：Gemini Enterprise 與「Gemini for Google Workspace」將 AI 代理人帶入 Gmail、Docs、Sheets 等應用，協助使用者撰寫、組織、視覺化內容，提升工作流程效率【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。

- **Google Cloud 與開發者平台**：在 Google Cloud 服務中，Gemini 企業版（Gemini Enterprise）提供企業客戶 AI 基礎設施與模型部署能力；Vertex AI 平台亦支援超過 200 種基礎模型，其中包括 Gemini 系列，讓開發者能存取、微調與部署自訂模型【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】【GOOGL_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。

- **其他產品與服務**：Gemini 模型已被嵌入至 Google 的多項產品與平台，涵蓋 Android、Chrome、YouTube、Google Play、Pixel 系列裝置等，形成全方位的 AI 生態系統【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  

透過上述多層面的整合，Google 讓 Gemini AI 成為搜尋即時回應、工作文件智能助理、雲端 AI 基礎設施以及廣大產品生態系的核心驅動力。

Alphabet Inc. Making AI Helpful for Everyone

We believe AI is a profound platform shift that can bring meaningful and positive change to people and societies across the world, and to our business. Our technical infrastructure allows us to use and offer our customers a range of AI accelerator options, including specialized Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) and our own custom-built Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), such as Ironwood, our seventh-generation TPU. Over the last decade, our research teams have pushed the boundaries of AI forward, which is displayed through Gemini 3, our most intelligent AI model yet. Designed to deliver advanced multimodal understanding, Gemini 3 represents our most capable iteration of agentic and generative coding technologies. Gemini 3 integrates enhanced reasoning capabilities to support visualizations and interactive user experiences across our product ecosystem, including Search and the Gemini app. As technology continues to improve rapidly, we are focused on bringing our latest AI advances to our products and platforms. records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google 搜尋透過加入 **AI Overviews** 與 **AI Mode** 兩項功能，直接回應生成式 AI 帶來的搜尋變革：AI Overviews 讓使用者只要提出任何問題，就能即時取得有用的回覆；而 AI Mode 則利用 Gemini 的先進推理、思考與多模態能力，讓使用者能提出更具細緻與複雜的問題，原本可能需要多次搜尋才能得到的資訊，現在可在一次互動中完成【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。這兩項 AI 產品先聚焦於提升使用者體驗，再考慮後續的變現策略，顯示 Google 正以技術創新來因應生成式 AI 對搜尋模式的衝擊【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #196】。

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是打造結合 AI、AR 與 VR 的沉浸式生態系統，並透過 Reality Labs 持續投入巨額資金進行硬體與軟體的研發與商業化。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25][META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67]

- **AI 與可穿戴裝置**：Meta 正在開發具備「Meta AI」對話助理的 AI 眼鏡（Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta），並於 2025 年推出結合顯示鏡片的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display，搭配可透過肌電訊號控制的 Meta Neural Band，顯示公司正朝向將 AI 深度整合於日常穿戴設備的方向前進。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]  
- **AR/VR 產品路線**：在 VR 方面，Meta 持續擴充 Meta Quest 裝置與 Horizon Store 內的軟體與內容，並加入「passthrough」技術讓使用者在虛擬與現實之間無縫切換；在 AR 方面，2024 年推出的 Orion 原型與 2025 年的 Ray‑Ban Display 代表公司正致力於提供視野寬廣、佩戴舒適的真實 AR 眼鏡。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25]  
- **AI 模型與平台投資**：Meta 表示將持續「開發與訓練」AI 模型，並不斷提升在 VR、Horizon 與可穿戴領域的新平台與技術投資，顯示其長期策略是以 AI 為核心驅動未來產品與服務的創新。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67]  
- **財務層面的長期投入**：Reality Labs 的重大投資在 2025 年已使整體營運利潤減少約 **191.9 億美元（$19.19 billion）**，且預期 2026 年的營運虧損將與 2025 年相似，說明公司願意在短期內接受巨額虧損，以換取長期技術與市場的突破。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67]  
- **風險與期望**：Meta 亦警告若這些投資未能成功，將對其業務與財務表現造成不利影響，顯示公司已將長期研發風險納入策略規劃中。[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #67]  

綜合上述，Meta 的長期願景是透過 AI 驅動的 AR/VR 硬體與內容平台，打造「隨時隨地」的沉浸式體驗；投資方向則聚焦於 AI 眼鏡、AR 原型、VR 互動技術以及持續加碼 Reality Labs 的研發與資本支出，即使短期內會大幅侵蝕營運利潤，也視為實現未來市場領先地位的必要投入。

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 主要靠廣告收入獲利，廣告的定價與投放方式由「每則廣告平均價格」決定，同時 Meta AI 作為跨平台的 AI 助手，嵌入 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Threads、WhatsApp 等應用，協助內容排序、廣告投放工具、生成式 AI 體驗以及提升產品開發效率【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。

**廣告獲利模式**  
- Meta 計算每則廣告的平均價格方式為「總廣告收入 ÷ 投放廣告數量」，此數字反映行銷人員為每則廣告（不論是曝光或行動目標）所支付的平均價格【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。  
- 廣告投放量會因產品而異，例如 Feed、Stories 的廣告變現率高於 Video 與 Reels，且公司會根據產品與變現策略不定期調整廣告的數量與頻率【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。  
- 若 Meta 不是廣告收入的主要承擔者，則會以淨額方式認列收入【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78】。  
- 2026 年第一季（Q1 FY2026）合併營收為 **563.1 億美元（$56.31 billion）**，較 2025 年第一季（Q1 FY2025）**增長 33%**（以報告貨幣計算），而在恆定匯率基礎上則 **增長 29%**【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #56】。此兩組數字分別對應「報告貨幣」與「恆定匯率」的不同計算基礎，故不互相衝突。  

**Meta AI 在旗下 App 中的角色**  
- Meta AI 是一個跨應用的 AI 助手，除了在各大社交平台（Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Threads、WhatsApp）內提供即時協助外，亦以獨立 App、AI 眼鏡與網頁形式存在【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
- 其功能包括協助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容以及連結他人，並在內容排序、推薦引擎、廣告工具、生成式 AI 體驗以及內部產品開發效率上提供支援【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
- 在「Family of Apps」的業務說明中，Meta AI 被列為 FoA 產品線的一部分，與 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 等共同構成平台的核心服務【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  

總結來說，Meta 透過廣告收入（以每則廣告平均價格與投放量為核心）創造主要營收，同時利用 Meta AI 在所有主要應用程式中提供 AI 助手與內容優化功能，進一步提升使用者體驗與廣告效益。

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 透過自家開發的全自動駕駛（FSD）與 Autopilot 系統，結合專屬的 AI 神經網路、內部設計的推論晶片，以及持續的 OTA（over‑the‑air）軟體更新，形成與競爭者的核心差異化【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  

- **全車輛皆為自動駕駛設計**：Tesla 表示「每一台今日交付的 Tesla 車輛皆為自動駕駛而設計」，即使目前仍需駕駛者保持注意力，這些系統已提供類似飛機自動駕駛的安全與便利功能【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **自研視覺與推論硬體**：公司使用視覺為基礎的技術、系統與軟體來訓練人工神經網路，並由自家客製化的推論晶片加速，這讓 Tesla 在 AI 與自動駕駛的演算法上保持領先【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **OTA 持續優化**：所有軟體（包括 FSD/Autopilot）皆透過 OTA 定期更新，讓車輛功能與安全性不斷提升，且每次更新都會加強軟體安全性【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **Robotaxi 服務作為差異化延伸**：2025 年 6 月推出的 Robotaxi 服務以 Model Y 為首批車型，未來將納入專為自動駕駛打造的 Cybercab，並結合 FSD（Supervised）訂閱，打造以 AI、軟體與車隊為基礎的服務驅動商業模式，進一步把自動駕駛技術轉化為營收來源【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **與競爭對手的差異點**：Tesla 在 10‑K 中指出，Robotaxi 將在自動駕駛與神經網路能力、Supercharger 充電網路、以及資訊娛樂系統等方面與傳統叫車與其他自動駕駛方案競爭，這些都是 Tesla 以 FSD 為核心的差異化優勢【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #44】。  
- **垂直整合與 AI 使命**：公司強調其「垂直整合的商業模式」與「將 AI 帶入現實世界」的使命，使其在自動駕駛技術的研發、製造與服務全流程中保持控制，這也是與其他僅提供軟體或硬體解決方案的競爭者的根本區別【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  

綜合以上，Tesla 以全車平台的自動駕駛設計、內部研發的 AI 與硬體、持續的 OTA 更新，以及以 Robotaxi 為載體的服務化策略，將 FSD/Autopilot 打造成與競爭對手明顯區隔的核心競爭力。

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We have planned electric vehicles to address additional vehicle markets, and will continue leveraging developments in our proprietary Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) features, battery cell and other technologies. Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Battery and Powertrain

Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Overview

We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence (“AI”) into the real world, through products and services like Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots (“Bots”) (including Optimus). We intend to leverage our current operations, in which we design, develop, manufacture, sell and lease high-performance fully electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems that increasingly deliver AI-related and enhanced software and services to our customers, to achieve that objective. We generally sell our products directly to customers, and continue to grow our global retail, service and charging footprint to accelerate the widespread adoption of our products. We emphasize performance, attractive styling and the safety of our users and workforce in the design and manufacture of our products and are continuing to develop full self-driving technology for improved safety. We also strive to lower the cost of ownership for our customers through continuous efforts to reduce manufacturing costs and by offering financial and other services tailored to our products. Our mission is building a world of amazing abundance. We believe that this mission, along with our engineering expertise, advancements in real-world AI, vertically integrated business model, and focus on user experience differentiate us from other companies. Segment Information

We operate as two reportable segments: (i) automotive and (ii) energy generation and storage. The automotive segment includes the design, development, manufacturing, sales and leasing of high-performance fully electric vehicles as well as sales of automotive regulatory credits. Additionally, the automotive segment also includes services and other, which includes sales of used vehicles, non-warranty maintenance services and collision, paid Supercharging sessions, automotive insurance business revenue, part sales and retail merchandise sales. The energy generation and storage segment includes sales, leasing, and financing of energy generation and storage products, services related to such products and sales of energy generation incentives. Our Products and Services

Automotive

We currently manufacture five different consumer vehicles – the Model 3, Y, S, X and Cybertruck. Model 3 is a four-door mid-size sedan that we designed for manufacturability with a base price for mass-market appeal. Model Y is a compact sport utility vehicle (“SUV”) built on the Model 3 platform with seating for up to seven adults. Model S is a four-door full-size sedan and Model X is a mid-size SUV with seating for up to seven adults. Model S and Model X feature the highest performance characteristics and longest ranges that we offer in a sedan and SUV, respectively. The Cybertruck is a full-size electric pickup truck with a stainless steel exterior that has the utility and strength of a truck while featuring the speed of a sports car. In 2022, we also began early production and deliveries of a commercial electric vehicle, the Tesla Semi.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] As we seek to become a top provider of autonomous solutions, we also face competition in the fields of AI and robotics. We expect our Robotaxi service to compete in this developing market, along with traditional ride-hailing and taxi services, through continued progress on our FSD (Supervised) and neural network capabilities, Supercharger network and infotainment offerings. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Systems

The market for energy storage products and services is also highly competitive, and both established and emerging companies have introduced products and services that are similar to our product portfolio or that are alternatives to the elements of our systems or software service offerings. We compete with these companies based on price, energy density, efficiency, optimization and performance. We believe that the specifications and features of our products, our strong brand and the modular, scalable nature of our energy storage products give us a competitive advantage in our markets. 10


Energy Generation Systems

The primary competitors to our energy generation business are the traditional local utility companies that supply energy to our potential customers. We compete with these traditional utility companies primarily based on price and the ease by which customers can switch to electricity generated by our energy generation systems. We also compete with solar energy companies that provide products and services similar to ours. Many solar energy companies only install solar energy systems, while others only provide financing for these installations. We believe we have a significant expansion opportunity with our offerings, including in terms of the aesthetics, superior performance and ease of installation and integration with Powerwall of our solar panels, and that the environment is increasingly conducive to the adoption of renewable energy systems. Intellectual Property

We place a strong emphasis on our innovative approach and proprietary designs which bring intrinsic value and uniqueness to our product portfolio. As part of our business, we seek to protect the underlying intellectual property rights of these innovations and designs such as with respect to patents, trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets, confidential information and other measures, including through employee and third-party nondisclosure agreements and other contractual arrangements. For example, we place a high priority on obtaining patents to provide the broadest and strongest possible protection to enable our freedom to operate our innovations and designs across all of our products and technologies as well as to protect and defend our product portfolio. We have also adopted a patent policy in which we irrevocably pledged that we will not initiate a lawsuit against any party for infringing our patents through activity relating to electric vehicles or related equipment for so long as such party is acting in good faith. We made this pledge in order to encourage the advancement of a common, rapidly-evolving platform for electric vehicles, thereby benefiting ourselves, other companies making electric vehicles and the world. Human Capital Resources 

Tesla’s ability to attract, develop and retain a talented workforce is a competitive advantage. As of December 31, 2025, our employee headcount worldwide was 134,785.

records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨來自傳統汽車大廠與新興電動車廠商的激烈競爭，且競爭範圍同時延伸至自動駕駛、能源儲存與機器人等相關領域。  

- **傳統與新興車廠的雙重挑戰**：Tesla 的車型（如 Cybertruck、Model S、Model X、Model 3、Model Y）不僅與既有的內燃機車輛競爭，也與其他已上市或計畫推出電動、混合動力、插電式混合動力及全電動車的製造商直接競爭，這些競爭者包括既有的大型汽車製造商以及新進入市場的公司【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #43】。  

- **自動駕駛技術的競爭**：在自動駕駛解決方案的採用率若未達預期，Tesla 可能因為其他公司在自動駕駛技術與服務上的投入而受到衝擊，因為市場上已出現越來越多既有與新興企業投入此領域【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59】。  

- **政府與經濟激勵的影響**：部分政府與經濟激勵措施可能偏向在本地組裝或使用本地供應鏈的製造商，這可能使競爭對手獲得更大的利益，進一步削弱 Tesla 的獲利能力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59】。  

- **資源與成本效率的差距**：許多競爭者擁有更充足或更成熟的資源，可在設計、開發、製造、分銷、推廣、銷售與支援方面投入更多，且因地理位置與經濟環境取得成本效益，這可能導致 Tesla 的車輛單位銷量下降、價格被迫下調、營收短缺、失去客戶與市場佔有率【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59】。  

- **能源產業的競爭**：在能源發電與儲存業務方面，Tesla 也面臨其他製造商、開發商、安裝商與服務提供者的競爭，甚至來自大型公用事業公司的挑戰，若電力零售或批發價格下降，可能使 Tesla 的產品吸引力下降，增加客戶違約風險【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59】。  

- **機器人與 Bots 事業的競爭**：Tesla 正在開發包括 Optimus 在內的機器人（Bots），但此領域仍屬新興產業，且已有其他公司在機器人設計、開發與製造上展開激烈競爭，若 Tesla 的 Bots 事業未能如預期發展，亦可能對其整體業務造成負面影響【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #59】。

records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 2025 年 10‑K 中指出，它在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦與平板電腦市場僅佔「少數」市場份額，且必須持續面對激烈的價格與技術競爭壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  

- 競爭環境方面，Apple 認為這些市場「高度競爭」且「價格競爭激烈、毛利率承受下行壓力」，產品生命週期短、產業標準快速演變，競爭者不斷推出新產品並快速採用新技術【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #21】。  
- 競爭者往往以「低成本結構」與「激進降價」來爭奪市場，甚至有些公司能以「幾乎不賺錢或虧損」的方式提供產品與服務，進一步壓低整體毛利率【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #21】。  
- Apple 也指出，競爭者會「模仿」其產品功能與應用，並可能「合作」提供整合解決方案，導致競爭進一步加劇【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  
- 在市場佔有率上，Apple 明確說明自己在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板電腦以及可穿戴裝置市場均只有「少數」的市場份額【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  

總結來說，Apple 自己在 10‑K 中描述的競爭壓力包括激烈的價格戰、毛利率下降、快速的產品迭代與技術模仿，而其在智慧型手機、PC 與平板等核心硬體市場的佔有率僅屬少數。

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 透過 App Store 的收入分潤、龐大的用戶基礎、硬體與服務的深度整合，以及開發者在平台上可獲得的較高營收潛力，建立了相較於 Android、Windows 等競爭平台更高的開發者黏著度。  

- Apple 依賴第三方開發者持續提供具吸引力且創新的應用程式，若開發者無法或選擇不跟上快速的技術變化，會導致應用程式無法提升客戶體驗、運作不正常，進而降低產品需求，顯示平台對開發者的依賴與互惠關係極為重要【AAPL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #60】。  
- 透過 App Store，Apple 會對應用程式銷售及應用內數位商品收取佣金；若開發者改用直接對消費者的分銷與付款模式，Apple 的佣金可能下降甚至無法取得，這直接影響 Apple 的營收、毛利與股價，因而激勵 Apple 維持對開發者的吸引力與公平的分潤機制【AAPL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #60】。  
- 開發者選擇在 Apple 平台上投入資源，取決於相較於 Android（手機與平板）或 Windows（個人電腦與平板）等競爭平台的「感知利益」——包括平台的市場地位、預期可產生的收入、產品銷售的未來成長以及開發成本【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #45】。  
- 雖然 Apple 在全球智慧手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置的市場佔有率較低，可能使部分開發者傾向於資源投入佔有率較高的競爭平台，但 Apple 仍透過高購買力的用戶基礎與高價值的硬體生態（iPhone、iPad、Mac、Apple Watch）提供較佳的收入潛力，提升開發者的黏著度【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #45】。  
- 為了維持這種黏著度，Apple 必須持續確保第三方內容與服務的可取得性、合理的授權條件以及有競爭力的分潤結構，否則開發者可能轉向 Android、Windows 或其他平台，對 Apple 的業務與股價產生不利影響【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #45】。  

綜合以上因素，Apple 透過經濟激勵、強大的硬體與服務整合、以及開發者對高收入潛力的感知，形成了相對於 Android、Windows 等平台更具黏著性的第三方開發者生態系。

The licensing or other distribution arrangements for this content can be for relatively short time periods and do not guarantee the continuation or renewal of these arrangements on commercially reasonable terms, or at all. Some third-party content providers and distributors currently or in the future may offer competing products and services, and can take actions to make it difficult or impossible for the Company to license or otherwise distribute their content. Other content owners, providers or distributors may seek to limit the Company’s access to, or increase the cost of, such content. The Company may be unable to continue to offer a wide variety of content at commercially reasonable prices with acceptable usage rules. The Company also produces its own digital content, which can be costly to produce due to intense and increasing competition for talent, content and subscribers, and may fail to appeal to the Company’s customers. The Company’s success depends largely on the talents and efforts of its team members, the continued service and availability of highly skilled employees, including key personnel, and the Company’s ability to nurture its distinctive and inclusive culture. Much of the Company’s future success depends on the talents and efforts of its team members and the continued availability and service of key personnel, including its Chief Executive Officer, executive team and other highly skilled employees. Experienced personnel in the technology industry are in high demand and competition for their talents is intense, especially in Silicon Valley, where most of the Company’s key personnel are located. Periods of intense competition for talent in particular fields can lead to increased costs as the Company seeks to offer competitive compensation to recruit and retain highly skilled employees.

[MSFT 10-K period 2026] We compete by providing secure, integrated industry-specific, and easy-to-use productivity and collaboration tools and services that create comprehensive solutions and work well with technologies our customers already have both on-premises or in the cloud. Windows faces competition from various software products and from alternative platforms and devices. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint competes with endpoint security solution providers. Our Enterprise Mobility + Security offerings compete with products from a range of competitors including identity vendors, security solution vendors, and numerous other security point solution vendors. LinkedIn faces competition from online professional networks; recruiting, talent management, and human resource services companies; job boards; companies that provide learning and development products and services; online and offline outlets that generate revenue from advertisers and marketers; and online and offline outlets for companies with lead generation and customer intelligence and insights. Dynamics competes with cloud-based and on-premises business solution providers. Intelligent Cloud

Our Intelligent Cloud segment consists of our public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services that power modern business and developers. This segment primarily comprises:

•Server products and cloud services, including Azure and other cloud services, comprising cloud and AI consumption-based services, GitHub cloud services, Health and Life Sciences cloud services (formerly Nuance Healthcare cloud services), virtual desktop offerings, and other cloud services; and Server products, comprising SQL Server, Windows Server, Visual Studio, System Center, related Client Access Licenses (“CALs”), and other on-premises offerings. •Enterprise and partner services, including Enterprise Support Services, Industry Solutions, Microsoft Partner Network, and Learning Experience. Server Products and Cloud Services

Azure is a comprehensive set of cloud services that offer developers, IT professionals, and enterprises freedom to build, deploy, and manage applications on any platform or device. Customers can use Azure through our global network of datacenters for computing, networking, storage, mobile and web application services, AI, and Internet of Things. Azure enables customers to devote more resources to development and use of applications that benefit their organizations, rather than managing on-premises hardware and software. Azure revenue is mainly affected by infrastructure-as-a-service and platform-as-a-service consumption-based services. Azure AI offerings provide a competitive advantage as companies seek ways to optimize and scale their business with AI. We offer supercomputing power for AI at scale to run large workloads, complemented by our rapidly expanding portfolio of AI cloud services (including the latest models) and hardware, which includes custom-built silicon and strong partnerships with chip manufacturers. Azure AI Foundry is a unified platform for developers to design, customize, and manage AI applications and agents. Our server products are designed to make IT professionals, developers, and their systems more productive and efficient.

[GOOGL 10-Q period 202606] Product sales revenue from hardware, net of estimated allowances for returns, and software is recognized generally when control of the hardware is transferred to the customer. Installation, support, and extended warranty services revenue are recognized ratably over the service period or as services are performed. Arrangements with Multiple Performance Obligations

At contract inception, we assess whether concurrent agreements with a customer should be accounted for as a single agreement. Our contracts with customers may include multiple performance obligations. For such arrangements, we allocate revenues to each performance obligation based on its relative standalone selling price. 11


Alphabet Inc. We generally determine standalone selling prices based on observable prices of our products and services sold or priced separately in comparable circumstances to similar customers. Customer Incentives and Credits

Certain customers receive cash-based incentives or credits, which are accounted for as variable consideration. We estimate these amounts based on the expected amount to be provided to customers and reduce revenues. We believe that there will not be significant changes to our estimates of variable consideration related to customer incentives and credits. Sales Commissions

We expense sales commissions when incurred when the period of the expected benefit is one year or less. We recognize an asset for certain sales commissions and amortize if the expected benefit period is greater than one year. These costs are recorded within sales and marketing expenses. Cost of Revenues

Cost of revenues consists of traffic acquisition costs (TAC) and other costs of revenues. •TAC includes:

◦amounts paid to our distribution partners who make available our search access points and other ad-supported services. Our distribution partners include browser providers, mobile carriers, original equipment manufacturers, and software developers; and

◦amounts paid to Google Network partners primarily for ads displayed on their properties. •Other cost of revenues includes:

◦content acquisition costs, which are payments to content providers from whom we license video and other content for distribution, primarily related to YouTube (we pay fees to these content providers based on revenues generated, subscriber counts, or a flat fee);

◦depreciation expense, primarily related to our technical infrastructure;

◦employee compensation expenses related to our technical infrastructure and other operations such as content review and customer and product support;

◦inventory and other costs related to the devices and TPU system hardware we sell; and

◦other technical infrastructure operations costs, including energy, equipment, and network capacity costs. Inventory

Inventory consists primarily of hardware related to TPU systems for sale to enterprise customers and devices, which primarily include the Pixel family of products. We utilize third-party contract manufacturers to manufacture our inventory. Our inventory includes raw material components purchased directly from our suppliers; work-in-process inventory undergoing conversion into finished products; and fully assembled finished goods. Inventories are stated at the lower of cost or net realizable value. Acquired Intangible Assets

Intangible assets with definite lives are amortized over their estimated useful lives on a straight-line basis generally over periods ranging from one to 10 years, and are subsequently removed from the presentation of gross intangible assets and accumulated amortization once they are fully amortized. Assets Held for Sale

We consider assets to be held for sale in the period when all of the criteria for a qualifying plan of sale are met. Upon designation as held for sale, we record the assets at the lower of their carrying value or their estimated fair value, reduced for the cost to sell the assets, and cease depreciation. Long-lived assets classified as held for sale are measured at fair value on a nonrecurring basis.

records.query: Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門最新一季營收表現如何？哪些因素互相抵銷？
records.answer:
Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門在最新一季（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三個月）營收下降了 **1.79 億美元（$179 百萬），跌幅約 1%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #71】。  

- **Windows 與 Devices** 營收減少 **1.03 億美元（$103 百萬），跌幅 2%**，其中 Windows OEM 雖因合作夥伴囤貨而有成長，但整體仍被 Devices 銷售下降所拖累【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #71】。  
- **Gaming** 營收下降 **3.8 億美元（$380 百萬），跌幅 7%**，主要受 Xbox 硬體與內容服務需求減少影響【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #71】。  
- **Search advertising** 營收則上升 **3.04 億美元（$304 百萬），增幅 9%**，抵消了部分硬體與遊戲的下滑【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #71】。  

因此，Windows/Devices 與 Gaming 的下滑被 Search advertising 的增長所部分抵銷，導致整體 More Personal Computing 營收僅小幅下降 1%。

records.query: NVIDIA 這一季在中國市場的資料中心晶片出貨狀況如何？跟去年同期相比有何變化？
records.answer:
本季（2027 財年第一季）NVIDIA 在中國的資料中心晶片出貨為 **零**，與去年同期（2026 財年第一季）出貨 **約 46 億美元** 相比，出貨量完全消失【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #47】。  

- 2027 財年第一季的中國客戶（總部位於中國）貢獻的營收為 **45.5 億美元**，較 2026 財年第一季的 **96.59 億美元** 大幅下降，顯示中國市場的整體營收也同步縮減【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #35】。  

因此，從出貨金額與營收兩個角度看，NVIDIA 本季在中國的資料中心晶片業務已從去年同期的數十億美元規模跌至無出貨，呈現顯著的負向變化。

[NVDA 10-Q period 202604] In August 2022, the USG announced export restrictions and export licensing requirements targeting China’s semiconductor and supercomputing industries. These restrictions impacted exports of certain chips, as well as software, hardware, equipment and technology used to develop, produce and manufacture certain chips to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and Russia, and specifically impact our A100 and H100 integrated circuits, DGX or any other systems or boards which incorporate A100 or H100 integrated circuits. In July 2023, the USG also informed us of an additional licensing requirement for a subset of A100 and H100 products destined to certain customers and other regions, including some countries in the Middle East. In October 2023, the USG announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including but not limited to, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam, but excluding Israel) of our products exceeding certain performance thresholds, including, but not limited to, the A100, A800, H100, H800, L4, L40, L40S RTX 4090, GB200 NVL72, and B200. The licensing requirements also apply to the export of products exceeding certain performance thresholds to a party headquartered in, or with an ultimate parent headquartered in, Country Group D5, including China. [NVDA 10-K period 2026] We work with industry leaders to help build or transform their applications and data center infrastructure. Some of our direct customers include original equipment manufacturers, or OEMs, original device manufacturers, or 

ODMs, system integrators and distributors which we partner with to help bring our products to market. We also have partnerships in automotive, healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, retail, and technology among others, to accelerate the adoption of AI. At the foundation of the NVIDIA accelerated computing platform are our GPUs, which excel at parallel workloads such as the training and inferencing of neural networks. These Data Center systems are extreme co-designed with the GPU, CPU, NVLink switch, DPU, NIC, and scale-out networking along with software stacks and algorithms to deliver data center-scale computing solutions. While our approach starts with powerful chips, what makes it a full-stack computing platform is our large body of software, including the CUDA development platform, the CUDA-X collection of acceleration libraries, AI models and training data sets, APIs, SDKs, and domain-specific application frameworks. In addition to software delivered to customers as an integral part of our data center computing and networking platform, we offer paid licenses to NVIDIA AI Enterprise, a comprehensive suite of enterprise-grade AI software and NVIDIA vGPU software for graphics-rich virtual desktops and workstations. In fiscal year 2025, we launched the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture, a full set of data center scale infrastructure that includes GPUs, CPUs, DPUs, interconnects, switch chips and systems, and networking adapters. Blackwell excels at processing cutting edge generative AI and accelerated computing workloads with market leading performance and efficiency. Offered in a number of configurations, for customers across industries and a diverse set of AI and accelerated computing use cases. In fiscal year 2026, we unveiled the NVIDIA Rubin platform, which is expected to commence production shipments in the second half of fiscal year 2027. Built for agentic AI and reasoning, it excels at processing multi-step problem-solving and massive long-context workflows, delivering up to a 10x reduction in cost per token compared to Blackwell.

[NVDA 10-K period 2026] NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to help solve the most challenging computational problems. NVIDIA is now a data center scale AI infrastructure company reshaping all industries. Our technology stack includes the foundational NVIDIA CUDA development platform that runs on all NVIDIA GPUs, as well as hundreds of domain-specific software libraries, frameworks, algorithms, software development kits, or SDKs, and application programming interfaces, or APIs. This deep and broad software stack accelerates the performance and facilitates the deployment of NVIDIA accelerated computing for computationally intensive workloads such as artificial intelligence, or AI, model training and inference, data analytics, scientific computing, robotics, and 3D graphics, with vertical-specific optimizations to address industries ranging from healthcare and telecom to automotive and manufacturing. Introduced with the Blackwell architecture, our data-center-scale offerings feature extreme co-design where the infrastructure’s chips, networking, systems, software, and algorithms are holistically architected and optimized to maximize performance and scale. Hundreds of thousands of GPUs can be interconnected to function as a single giant computer. This type of data center architecture and scale is needed for the development and deployment of modern AI and accelerated computing applications. The GPU was initially used to simulate human imagination, enabling the virtual worlds of video games and films. Today, it also simulates human intelligence, enabling a deeper understanding of language, science, and the physical world. Its parallel processing capabilities, supported by tens of thousands of computing cores, are essential for deep learning algorithms. records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:
因為 NVIDIA 同時提供高效能的硬體、完整的軟體堆疊與龐大的開發者生態系，使得 AI 開發者能快速、可靠地建置與部署模型，其他公司難以在短時間內複製這樣的全方位平台【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。

1. **硬體領先與全堆疊解決方案**  
   - NVIDIA 的 GPU 被設計為 AI 專用的 Tensor Core，且在資料中心規模上結合了 GPU、CPU（Grace）與 DPU，形成端到端的加速運算平台【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。  
   - Blackwell 架構與 Blackwell Ultra 平台進一步提升了 token 吞吐量與每 token 成本，提供比前代 Hopper 更佳的效能與成本效益【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。

2. **軟體與開發工具的深度整合**  
   - CUDA 開發平台自 2006 年起即支援所有 NVIDIA GPU，成為全球超過 750 萬開發者的共同基礎，讓軟體能直接利用 GPU 的平行運算能力【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
   - NVIDIA AI Enterprise 包含 NIM、NeMo、AI Blueprints 等完整套件，簡化企業級生成式 AI 應用的開發與部署【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
   - 公司的軟體堆疊還涵蓋了針對醫療、汽車、設計等垂直產業的專屬庫與框架（如 Clara、DRIVE、Omniverse），提供即插即用的解決方案【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。

3. **生態系與市場滲透**  
   - NVIDIA 的平台已被所有主要伺服器製造商與雲端服務提供商（CSP）採用，形成「幾乎每一家主要 CSP」都使用其資料中心規模基礎設施的局面【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
   - 超過 750 萬開發者使用 CUDA 及相關工具，並透過 Inception 計畫與數千家新創公司、數百所大學合作，持續擴大技術影響力【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  
   - 公司的技術已滲透至廣告、搜尋、推薦系統、社交媒體等多個「數十億」終端使用者的服務中，形成強大的網路效應【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。

4. **研發投入與創新歷史**  
   - 自 1999 年發明 GPU 以來，NVIDIA 持續投入超過 **767 億美元（$76.7 billion）** 的研發資金，推動從 PC 遊戲圖形到現代 AI 的全方位創新【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
   - 重要里程碑包括 2006 年推出 CUDA、2012 年 AlexNet 在 NVIDIA GPU 上贏得 ImageNet、2017 年首款 Tensor Core GPU、以及 2023 年推出的 Grace CPU，皆為 AI 生態奠定基礎【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】。

5. **市場定位與競爭壁壘**  
   - NVIDIA 自稱為「資料中心規模 AI 基礎建設公司」，其硬體、軟體、演算法與模型皆在同一平台上協同設計，形成難以被單一競爭者模仿的整合優勢【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  
   - 這種「硬體‑軟體‑系統‑演算法」的全方位共設計，使得其他僅提供單一元件（如僅有 GPU 或僅有軟體）的公司難以提供同等的效能與開發便利性【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。

綜合以上，NVIDIA 之所以成為 AI 產業的事實標準，是因為它同時掌握了領先的硬體、成熟的軟體平台、龐大的開發者社群與深度的產業整合，形成了高進入障礙的競爭壁壘，使得其他公司難以在短期內複製其完整的 AI 生態系統【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #40】。

records.answer:
微軟是透過在 Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品組合中加入 **Microsoft 365 Copilot**，以及一系列 AI‑enabled 工具、功能與 agentic 場景，將 AI 直接嵌入 Office 相關的雲端服務與應用程式中【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。  

- Microsoft 365 Copilot 讓 Office、Windows 以及其他生產力服務在同一平台上結合生成式 AI，提供 AI‑驅動的工具與新功能，涵蓋溝通、協作、分析、資安與合規等多個商務生產力領域【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #35】。  
- 為支援 Copilot 席位與使用量的成長，微軟在 AI 基礎建設上投入大量資源，導致成本項目上升 10%，顯示公司正透過擴充 AI 計算容量與人才來強化這些 AI 功能的運作【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #74】。  

因此，微軟的做法是以 Microsoft 365 Copilot 為核心，結合 AI‑enabled 工具與場景，並在背後投入 AI 基礎設施與研發，以在 Office 產品中提供 AI 助理功能。

records.query: 亞馬遜最近在 AI 這塊砸錢做了什麼？跟哪家 AI 公司搭上線？
records.answer:
亞馬遜近期在生成式 AI 領域投入超過百億美元，與 OpenAI 以及 Anthropic 兩家領先的 AI 公司簽訂了大規模的合作與投資協議，並持續擴大相關的多年度合約與股權投資。  

- **與 OpenAI 的合作與投資**：2026 年第一季，AWS 與 OpenAI 擴大原有 **380 億美元（$38.0 billion）** 的多年度合作，額外再增 **1,000 億美元（$100.0 billion）** 的 8 年合約，涵蓋 AWS 晶片的執行需求【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #33】。同時，亞馬遜於 2026 年第一季投資 **150 億美元（$15.0 billion）** 購買 OpenAI Series C 優先股，並簽署一份承諾購買額外 **350 億美元（$35.0 billion）**（Commitment Amount）的股權認購協議【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38】。在 2026 年第二季，亞馬遜再投入 **137 億美元（$13.7 billion）** 至該承諾金額，累計至 2026 年底的 Series C 投資金額為 **287 億美元（$28.7 billion）**，隨後又投入剩餘的 **213 億美元（$21.3 billion）**【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，亞馬遜在未採用權益法的私募股權投資（主要為 OpenAI 與 Anthropic）帳面價值達 **1,223 億美元（$122.3 billion）**【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #40】。

- **與 Anthropic 的合作與投資**：2026 年第二季，AWS 與 Anthropic 宣布擴大既有的多年度合作，新增超過 **1,000 億美元（$100.0 billion）** 的 10 年合約，同樣包括 AWS 晶片的執行需求【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #35】。亞馬遜亦於 2026 年第一季投資 **50 億美元（$5.0 billion）** 購買 Anthropic 的非投票優先股，並設立最高 **200 億美元（$20.0 billion）** 的融資設施，供 Anthropic 在達成特定算力里程碑後提取資金【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #38】。

- **整體 AI 相關支出趨勢**：公司在 2026 年第二季的技術與基礎設施成本因基礎設施（含折舊與攤銷）支出上升，導致六個月期間較去年同期增加 **4.27 億美元（$427 million）**，其中包括支援 AI 與機器學習的相關投資【AMZN_10Q_202606.html, chunk #79】。

綜合上述，亞馬遜正透過巨額合約擴張與股權投資，與 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 兩大 AI 企業深度結合，以加速其在雲端 AI 服務與自家硬體（AWS 晶片）上的布局。

Technology and infrastructure costs include payroll and related expenses for employees involved in the research and development of new and existing products and services, development, design, and maintenance of our stores, curation and display of products and services made available in our online stores, and infrastructure costs. Infrastructure costs include servers, networking equipment, and data center related depreciation and amortization, rent, utilities, and other expenses necessary to support AWS and other Amazon businesses. Collectively, these costs reflect the investments we make in order to offer a wide variety of products and services to our customers, including expenditures related to initiatives to build and deploy innovative and efficient software and electronic devices and the development of a satellite network for global broadband service and autonomous vehicles for ride-hailing services. We seek to invest efficiently in numerous areas of technology and infrastructure so we may continue to enhance the customer experience and improve our process efficiency through rapid technology developments, while operating at an ever increasing scale. Our technology and infrastructure investment and capital spending projects often support a variety of product and service offerings due to geographic expansion and the cross-functionality of our systems and operations. We expect spending in technology and infrastructure to increase over time as we continue to add infrastructure and employees, including to support our artificial intelligence and machine learning initiatives. These costs are allocated to segments based on usage. The increase in technology and infrastructure costs in Q2 2026 and for the six months ended June 30, 2026, compared to the comparable prior year periods, is primarily due to an increase in spending on infrastructure, including depreciation and amortization. Changes in foreign exchange rates did not significantly impact technology and infrastructure costs for Q2 2026, but increased technology and infrastructure costs by $427 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026. Technology and infrastructure costs in Q2 2026 include net unrealized gains for energy contracts that are subject to derivative accounting, primarily related to AWS. Fair value measurements for these contracts do not impact cash flows but may be material to technology and infrastructure costs in future periods due to the duration of these contracts and volatility inherent in valuation methods.

records.query: Google 的 AI 助手現在有整合進搜尋引擎裡嗎？
records.answer:
Google 已經將 AI 助手功能整合進搜尋引擎，透過「AI Overviews」與「AI Mode」讓使用者在 Google Search 中直接得到更自然、具多模態的回應與深入的問題解析【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #196】。  

- 這些 AI 服務是以 Gemini 大型語言模型為基礎，提供更自然語言的查詢體驗，並在搜尋結果頁面即時呈現 AI 產生的概覽與多步驟推理答案【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132】。  
- 企業與消費者皆可透過此方式在搜尋時即時使用 AI 助手，顯示 Google 正在將 AI 深度嵌入其核心搜尋產品中。

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] [section: Understanding Alphabet’s Financial Results] As we continue to incorporate AI into our products and services, such as with AI Overviews and AI Mode in Search, and with enterprise AI solutions on our Google Cloud Platform, we may monetize differently than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings which could affect revenue growth rates and margin trends. When developing new products and services we generally focus first on user experience and then on monetization. At the same time, we face increasing competition, including from other developers and providers of AI products and services, which may affect our revenues. Increasing Revenues Beyond Advertising: Revenues from cloud, consumer subscriptions, platforms, and devices, which may have differing characteristics than our advertising revenues, have grown over time. Certain of these revenues have been growing at a rate higher than our advertising revenues, becoming a larger percentage of our consolidated revenues, and we expect this trend to continue. The margins on these revenues vary significantly and are generally lower than the margins on our advertising revenues. Increased Investment in Technical Infrastructure: We continue to invest in capital expenditures as we scale our technical infrastructure, in particular for AI, to meet the demand of our users and enterprise customers and to support research internally. We invested heavily in capital expenditures in 2025 and in 2026, we expect to significantly increase, relative to 2025, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers and network equipment, and data centers. The costs associated with operating our technical infrastructure - depreciation, energy, equipment, and network capacity - are expected to significantly increase as developing and serving AI offerings require more compute power than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings. While our technical infrastructure costs increase, we expect to continue to drive efficiencies in our data centers, for example, through the design of our AI models and our TPU and GPU-based technical infrastructure. Continued Investment in Intellectual Property through R&D and Acquisitions: We continue to make significant research and development investments in areas of strategic focus as we seek to develop new, innovative offerings, and improve our existing offerings across our businesses. Acquisitions and strategic investments remain important elements in our use of capital and contribute to the breadth and depth of our offerings, expand our expertise in engineering and other functional areas, and build strong partnerships around strategic initiatives. Alphabet Inc. Our products and services have come a long way since the company was founded more than 25 years ago. While Google Search started as a way to find web pages, organized into ten blue links, we have driven technical advancements and product innovations that have transformed Google Search into a dynamic, multimodal experience. Large language models have made it possible to express more natural language queries, vastly improving the types of questions users can ask, and the quality of results. records.query: Meta 搞的那些 VR 眼鏡跟 AI，到底想往哪個方向發展？
records.answer:
Meta 正在把 VR 眼鏡與 AI 深度結合，朝向打造沉浸式的元宇宙平台與「個人超智慧」體驗發展【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。  

- **沉浸式硬體與軟體整合**：Meta 透過 Reality Labs 推出 Meta Quest 系列 VR 裝置，並加入「passthrough」功能，讓使用者在保持實體感的同時體驗全沉浸式內容【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。同時，Meta 正在研發更先進的 AR 眼鏡，例如 2024 年的 Orion 原型機，具備業界領先的視野與舒適度【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。2025 年推出的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display 結合鏡片內嵌顯示器，並配合 Meta Neural Band 以肌電訊號控制，顯示出公司在硬體創新上的長期布局【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  

- **AI 助手與生成式 AI 應用**：Meta AI 作為跨平台的 AI 助手，已內建於所有主要應用（Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、Threads）以及 AI 眼鏡，提供「學習、完成任務、創作內容」等功能【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。公司持續投資於生成式 AI 與超智慧模型，旨在提升內容推薦、廣告投放與測量精準度，同時支援新產品與功能的開發【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #29】。  

- **元宇宙願景與長期策略**：Meta 把元宇宙描述為「下一代計算平台」，認為它將取代傳統 2D 螢幕，成為未來社交與互動的核心【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #22】。為此，公司將 AI、可穿戴裝置與沉浸式硬體結合，打造「個人超智慧」的生態系統，並透過開源 Llama 基礎模型等方式促進 AI 研究與創新【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #29】。  

- **風險與挑戰**：Meta 在 Reality Labs 的硬體開發仍屬新領域，缺乏消費者硬體經驗，可能使競爭對手更具優勢；同時，硬體需與第三方行動平台兼容，若互操作性不足可能影響產品接受度【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】。公司也指出，若無法從其他業務產生足夠利潤支撐這些投資，將對財務結果產生不利影響【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #165】。  

- **財務與資源配置**：Meta 在 2025 年的資產負債表顯示現金 811.8 億美元（$81.18 billion）、負債 867.7 億美元（$86.77 billion），並持續將資金投入 AI 與 VR/AR 研發，以支撐其長期元宇宙與超智慧目標【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #1】。  

綜合以上，Meta 正以 AI 驅動的 VR/AR 硬體、生成式 AI 服務與開放式模型為核心，致力於構建一個以沉浸式體驗與個人超智慧為特徵的未來元宇宙平台。

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. [META 10-K period 2025] Our product development philosophy centers on continuous innovation in creating and improving products that are social by design, which means that our products are designed to place people and their social interactions at the core of the product experience. Historically, the increases in our computing needs have been driven by growth in our user base as well as engagement with products like video and VR. Our increased efforts toward building frontier AI models have driven a significant further expansion in our computing needs and we expect our computing needs to continue to expand as a result. records.query: 特斯拉的自動駕駛跟別家車廠比，厲害在哪裡？
records.answer:
特斯拉的自動駕駛之所以被認為較其他車廠更具優勢，主要在於它全方位自研的 AI 與視覺系統、專屬的推論晶片、以及透過 OTA 方式持續升級的軟體平台，且每一台交付的車輛皆是為自動駕駛而設計，此外已於 2025 年推出 Robotaxi 服務，率先進入以 AI、軟體與車隊營運為核心的服務型商業模式【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。

- **AI 與視覺技術**：特斯拉利用視覺為基礎的感測技術與系統，訓練自家的人工神經網路，並以自製的推論晶片加速運算，這些都是公司內部自行開發的核心能力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **全車軟體自研與 OTA 更新**：車輛的控制、性能、充電、資訊娛樂等功能皆由特斯拉自行開發軟體，並透過無線 OTA 方式定期更新，持續提升自動駕駛功能與安全性【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **每台車皆為自動駕駛設計**：特斯拉聲稱目前交付的每一輛車都具備自動駕駛的硬體基礎，並認為此硬體與軟體的結合在競爭對手中形成差異化優勢【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  
- **Robotaxi 商業化先行**：2025 年 6 月，特斯拉正式啟動 Robotaxi 自動駕駛共乘平台，已開始以 Model Y 車型提供服務，未來將擴充至專為自動駕駛設計的 Cybercab，這是目前市場上少數已實際營運的自動駕駛車隊服務【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。  

相較於其他汽車製造商，特斯拉的優勢在於上述完整且自研的軟硬體生態系統，以及已經落地的 Robotaxi 服務，這使其在自動駕駛技術的落實與商業化上領先於競爭對手【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #25】。

records.query: 微軟的雲端服務最近成長得快不快？
records.answer:
微軟的雲端服務近期成長相當快速，商務版雲端收入年增約 18%‑19%，消費者版雲端收入年增約 29%‑33%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #73】【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。

- 在截至 2026 年 3 月的九個月期間，Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud（商務版雲端）收入增長 18%，而 Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud（消費者版雲端）收入增長 29%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #73】。  
- 在截至 2026 年 3 月的最近一季（2026 Q1），Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud 收入增長 19%，Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud 收入增長 33%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  
- 這兩段期間的雲端收入增長均高於整體 Productivity and Business Processes 部門的總收入增幅（九個月期間總收入增長 16%，單季增長 17%）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #73】【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  
- 雲端收入的強勁增長也推動毛利提升，毛利在單季增加 18%（主要來自 Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  

因此，從最新的九個月與單季數據看，微軟的雲端服務以兩位數的年增率持續快速擴張。
